Architectural Lighting System (Ireland / EU Retail Standard)

Specified to Irish commercial retail standards (BS EN 12464-1 / NSAI / CE / UKCA) featuring 3000K warm CCT, ultra-high CRI 98 (R9 > 90), and DALI-2 intelligent dimming control.

1.0 × 0.8 CM PROFILE
✦ FIXTURE L-01 • SHELF HALO

Dotless COB Micro-Extrusion

CCT / CRI:3000K / CRI 98 (R9 > 90)
Profile Run:240 cm Linear Runs
Driver Protocol:Tridonic 24V DALI-2 Dimmable
Extrusion:1.0 × 0.8 cm Anodized + Opal

Eliminates visible diode reflection on glass flacons; enhances golden perfume hue.

25 CM COFFER DROP

Driver:Osram Optotronic 24V DALI
Compliance:CE / ENEC / BS 5266

Section 06

Materials & Finishes Specification Board

Luxury Calacatta Gold marble, titanium gold PVD coatings, and crystal glass specifications.

MAT-01 • FLOOR & SURFACES
Calacatta Gold Marble
Polished Italian porcelain marble slab with distinct warm gold and grey veining. Non-porous sealed, high traffic resistance.
MAT-02 • METAL JOINERY
Brushed Titanium Gold PVD
Grade 304 stainless steel with physical vapor deposition (PVD) coating. Anti-fingerprint, scratch hardness ≥2000 HV.
MAT-03 • FEATURE PANELS
Geometric Gold Relief Backplate
Precision CNC-milled diamond relief panels finished in satin champagne gold lacquer for perfume display backdrops.
MAT-04 • COUNTERTOPS
Calacatta Countertop Slab
2.0 cm solid bullnose-profiled marble slab with integrated perfume testing flush inserts and stain-resistant sealer.
